## Config

| Property          | Type                         | Description                                           | Default                    |
|:------------------|:-----------------------------|:------------------------------------------------------|:---------------------------|
| Next              | `func(fiber.Ctx) bool`       | Skip when the function returns `true`.                | `nil`                      |
| PanicHandler      | `func(fiber.Ctx, any) error` | Customize the error returned from a recovered panic. `DefaultPanicHandler` returns the panic value when it is an `error` and `fmt.Errorf("%v", r)` otherwise. | `DefaultPanicHandler`      |
| EnableStackTrace  | `bool`                       | Call `StackTraceHandler` with the recovered value when a panic is caught. The stack trace is not added to the returned error or the response. | `false`                    |
| StackTraceHandler | `func(fiber.Ctx, any)`       | Handle the captured panic when `EnableStackTrace` is `true`. The default writes `recovered panic: <value>` and the stack trace to `os.Stderr`. | `defaultStackTraceHandler` |

## Config

| Property    | Type               | Description                                                          | Default |
|:------------|:-------------------|:---------------------------------------------------------------------|:-------|
| Next        | `func(fiber.Ctx) bool` | Function to skip this middleware when it returns `true`.            | `nil`  |
| Timeout     | `time.Duration`    | Timeout duration for requests. `0` or a negative value disables the timeout. | `0`    |
| OnTimeout   | `fiber.Handler`    | Handler executed when a timeout occurs. It may write the response itself or return a `*fiber.Error`, whose status and message then form the response; otherwise the default 503 is sent. After the deadline it runs on a context of its own, see [Known limitations](#known-limitations). Defaults to returning `fiber.ErrServiceUnavailable`. | `nil`  |
| Errors      | `[]error`          | Custom errors treated as timeout errors, in addition to `context.DeadlineExceeded`. A handler that returns one of them (checked with `errors.Is`) gets the timeout response. | `nil`  |

request.instructions: The documents are sections of the documentation of ONE open-source project at one commit. Report a conflict only when two sections make incompatible statements about the SAME option, flag, default value, limit, version requirement, or behavior, for the same product version and scope. These are NOT conflicts: values of different options; example values in code samples that merely override a default; statements explicitly scoped to an older version or to migration history; one section giving more detail than the other; different defaults that the text ties to different contexts (per-route vs global, dev vs build, agent mode vs server mode).
